units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:10">Shebi. IV, 10</cite> <he>מותר לקוֹצְצוֹ</he> it is permitted to cut the tree down (in the Sabbatical year).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:10">Ib.</cite> <he>כמה … ולא יְקוֹצֶּנּוּ</he> (Y. ed. <he>יקצונו</he>, corr. acc.; Bab. ed. <he>יְקוֹצְצוֹ</he>; Ms. M. <he>יִקְצְצֶנּוּ</he>) how much must an olive tree bear so that one dare not cut it down (because it is an act of wilful destruction, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 20:19-20">Deut. XX, 19–20</cite>); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 91b:18">B. Kam. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>יקצצנו</he> Ms. F. a. R. (later ed. <he>יִקְצְצוֹ</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 91b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>נטיעותי קָצַצְתָּ</he> thou hast cut down my young trees; <he>אתה אמרת לי לקוֹצְצָן</he> (not <he>לקוצצו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) thou hast told me to cut them.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:5:2">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>לָקוֹץ … יָקוֹץ</he>, v. <cite ref="N01387"><he>נָתַק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:5:2">Ib.</cite> <he>הקוצץ בקורות</he> he that cuts trunks for beams.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>, v. infra.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 212:2">Sifré Deut. 212</cite> (expl. <he>ועשתה</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:12">Deut. XXI, 12</cite>) <he>תָּקוֹץ</he> let her cut (her nails).

<cite ref="Makkot 22a:7">Macc. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>הקוצץ את בהרתו</he> he that cuts off a white spot (suspicious of leprosy, v. <cite ref="S01821"><he>קְצִיצָה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 7:5">Neg. VII, 5</cite> <he>קְצָצָהּ מתכוין</he> if he cut it intentionally.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 11:3">Tosef. Sabb. XI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:3">XII</cite>), 3; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Daniel 5:1">Dan. V, 1</cite> a.
<cite ref="Daniel 6:1">VI, 1</cite>) <he>והיכן הוא … קוצץ לקוצץ</he> where is Evil Merodach?… (He is left out) in order to join a wicked man to a wicked man, a destroyer to a destroyer.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:6:3">Y. Yeb. II, 4ᵃ</cite> top <he>קוצץ בן קוצץ</he> a destroyer son of a destroyer (wicked by heredity); Pesik. S’liḥ. p. 167ᵇ <he>אין בישראל קו׳ בן קו׳</he> there is no hereditary wickedness in Israel.
Ex. R. s. 1 וקוץ … שק׳ עצת וכ׳ Koz (I Chr. IV, 8) is Caleb, for he destroyed the counsel of the spies; a. fr.—2) (cmp. קָצַב, גָּזַר) to stipulate, agree upon.
<cite ref="Shevuot 45b:1">Shebu. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ ק׳ נמי</he> let it be the same even if a stipulation has been made (and the amount is in litigation).

<cite ref="Shevuot 45b:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אומן … קָצַצְתָּ … לא קָצַצְתִּי וכ׳</he> if the mechanic says, thou hast stipulated to pay me two (Zuz), and he (the employer) says, I have stipulated one only; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>קָצוּץ</he>; f. <cite ref="S01796"><he>קְצוּצָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 61b:15">B. Mets. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>רבית ק׳</he> stipulated, direct usury, opp. <he>אבק רבית</he>, v. <cite ref="A00188"><he>אָבָק</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 62b">Ib. 62ᵇ</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be cut. Neg. l. c. מי … ונִקְצָצָה if one had a white spot, and it was cut off (accidentally).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:1">Nidd. II, 1</cite> <he>תִּקָּצֵץ</he> let the hand be cut off.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 91b">B. Kam. 91ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01821"><he>קְצִיצָה</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be cut off, excluded. Y. Kidd. I, 60ᶜ, a. e., v. קְצָצָה.

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>, beg. <he>מראש השנה נִקְצָצִין וכ׳</he> from the beginning of the year the means of support are definitely assigned to men, except &c., v. <cite ref="S01783"><he>קָצַב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:3">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ דלתות וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="II Kings 18:16">II Kings XVIII, 16</cite>) he took the gold off the Temple doors. Y. Ber. VIII, 12ᵃ bot. <he>אפי׳ מְקַצֵּץ וכ׳</he> even when cutting lupines. Ib. II, 5ᶜ top <he>היה מקצץ כל וכ׳</he> he cut down all he had planted.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>ומְקַצְּצִים</he>, v. <cite ref="T01001"><he>רָצַץ</he></cite>.
Cant. R. to II, 2 לקַצְּצוֹ; Lev. R. s. 23 לָקוֹצּוֹ, v. קַצָּץ.—Esp. ק׳ בנט עות [to cut down the shoots in the garden of religion,] to be hostile to religion, corrupt the youths; to be a heretic.
<cite ref="Chagigah 14b:9">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. II, 77ᵇ top, v. <cite ref="N00563"><he>נְטִיעָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:4:5">Cant. R. to I, 4</cite> <he>כיצד ק׳ בנ׳</he> in what way did he manifest his hostility to religion? <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>לא תעשה … וִיקַצֵּץ וכ׳</he> make not the fence (around the religious laws) more important than the essentials, lest it fall down and ruin the shoots.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:1">Shebi. IV, 1</cite> <he>ואין … שיְקַצֵּץ להם מזונות</he> (R. S. <he>שיִקְצוֹץ</he>) it is unnecessary to say, that he must not stipulate to give them their food (for their work).
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 8:1">Sifré Num. 8</cite> <he>ומֵקֵיץ מכתובתה</he> he may deduct (his outlay for her) from her jointure.
